title: The Wheel of the Year

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Brother Thomas painted these cards of the year's seasons, but the wind blew them off the shelf!

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Winter is here now. Can you put the seasons in order, starting with spring?

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Put the seasons in order, starting with spring.
steps.hint: Spring is when seeds sprout. What comes after?

feedback.out_of_order: Some cards came back. What comes after spring?
feedback.all_good: Spring, summer, autumn, winter, and round again to spring!

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Winter always turns to spring. It always has, and it always will. That's a promise you can see.

journal_line: I put the seasons of the year in order at the monastery.
